balls.text: McCullum moves away again, Trivedi follows him again but wisely keeps it fuller. McCullum can't get under this one and whip-drags through square leg and hustles across for the second. 15 runs off the over, and RR's RRR is 7.2.

aha, typical Twenty20 from McCullum. He starts backing away even as Trivedi gets into delivery stride, and by the time the ball comes he is on the side crease! Trivedi helps the cause by following him instead of keeping it outside off, in which case McCullum could have never reached it. It lands short of a length and sits up, McCullum does well to muscle the heave all the way over midwicket. Pune's flourish has finally come, in the last over.

an action replay of the previous ball, except that this time Trivedi his the stumps at his end, and Rahul is gone. Slow and short offcutter outside off, Rahul has a carve and misses. He looks to run and transfer strike to McCullum, who is through in a flash. The relay throw comes to Trivedi, who takes aim and sends a stumps out of the turf.
McCullum backs away, Trivedi tries to follow him and then McCullum heaves and misses. They then run a bye, Trivedi gets the relay throw and has a go, but misses the stumps.

Manhas is gone, Trivedi surprises him with a touch of extra pace, and Manhas is hurried into the pull off the front foot. It goes high towards midwicket. Binny sprints in, slides and completes another good catch. Rajasthan have been brilliant in the field.

finally a six. And what a laboured one. Manhas has strained every sinew in his body to haul this over the wide long-on fence. The patent slow off-cutter from Trivedi, lands on a length, pings the meat of the bat and flies into the stands.

Rahane is everywhere. Full and fast from Watson, outside off, McCullum creams it through the covers, Rahane prances from the sweeper position, dives full length and hauls it in, a couple of feet in front of the boundary. Electric stuff from the young man.
angles the bouncer down the leg side again, and it is called wide.
is that Watson's first full ball today? It is a reverse-swinging yorker, curling in late, and Manhas does well to block it to the off side and run.
slow bouncer, McCullum gets over it and plays it down to square leg for one
back of a length outside off, McCullum charges half out and throws his bat at it without making contact.
Manhas survives a close-run thing. Full outside off, he steers to short third and bolts, the throw from Binny misses. A direct hit would have ended Manhas' stay.
bumper from the round the wicket, too short and wide. Called.

Rahane's held on to one of the tougher outfield catches you will see. Short ball from Watson, he could not have been more predictable if he had held aloft a banner saying "Deadling exclusively in short balls". Yet, Harpreet was in no position to pull and top-edged off the front foot. Rahane ran across from deep square leg, slid and held as it came down over his shoulder.

slower legcutter, came out of Amit's hand, landed on a length, and just scooted along like a gopher. Manhas had no chance of connecting with that, as he looked to cut, a foot above where the ball went.
Harpreet mis-hits another leg-side shot, this time the swiped flick from leg-stump line. Single to the deep.
fuller length on off, Manhas pushes from the crease into the covers for a single

surprise surprise. A pull shot has managed to reach the fence. Short, sitting up, asking to be pulled, and Manhas finally finds the fence. Nicely played, rolled the wrists over it. First four in 38 balls.
slow bouncer at 118 kph, Harpreet's grip is wrong. No two ways about it. Another pull heaved away with no timing at all.
full and on middle and leg as Manhas advances, he gets too close to the ball and inside edges it onto the pads for a single into the covers.

aha, gets the legbreak to dart away and Manhas edges it just past slip. They go for a quick single, the fielder from short third-man lets rip a throw, but Harpreet beats the direct hit. Eventful end to an eventful spell from Warney.
shortens the length, hurries onto Harpreet who cross-bats a single
tossed up on a length outside off, Harpreet works it back to Warne with the spin.
Manhas trots out to a drifting leggie, gets to the pitch and pushes it into the covers for a single.
shortens the length on leg stump, Manhas cuts as it breaks away, for a single through point.
tossed up on the toes, driven with the spin into the covers for a single
another bouncer, Harpreet ducks under it cleanly this time.
Watson can always find work at a bar. As a bouncer. Short again, cross-batted to midwicket for one.
another short ball, Harpreet whip-slaps uppishly through midwicket.
full toss outside off, Harpreet cracks an extra-cover drive to the man in the deep. Gets a couple.
Watto hasn't given anything to drive. Another short ball, Manhas pulls through square leg.
another bumper, Harpreet's pulling needs some working on. He mistimes it to square leg for one.
bumper at reasonable pace, for someone with Trivedi's limitations, Harpreet guides the pull to deep square leg for one.
Trivedi angles into the pads, it is glanced backward of square for a single
full length on off stump, Manhas flicks elegantly to the deep for a couple
keeps it outside off, Manhas gets across close to the pitch and steers through point.
short of a length, hurries Manhas back in the crease and defends to the off side
full and angling across, driven into the covers defensively for a single
back of a length ball on the pads, Harpreet whips in strange fashion to the leg side for a single.
nicely directed bouncers these, 126 kph and through Harpreet in a flash. The line was impeccable, he could not do much with it, Harpreet, and weaved away.
another poorly executed pull. 125 kph, short ball on leg stump, Harpreet gets a bottom edge straight down the track. Watson collects.
slow bouncer, at 117 kph, and Manhas is all awry on the pull and gets it away backward of square for one.
short ball, Harpreet controls the pull along the round for a single.
short of a length ball outside off, Harpreet defends from the crease.
back of a length, Harpreet pushes a single down the ground. Pune need someone to step up here.

Pandey, what have you done? How many times have we seen him throw his wicket away in the IPL? What a moment to combust. Trivedi's innocuous nothing-ball does it again. It is a slow full ball on off stump, Pandey looks to brutalise it over midwicket, as he cross-bats. It loops up in the air and lands in deep midwicket's hands.
gets a single this time, dabbing a length ball into the covers.
length ball on off, defended into the off side, with a touch of JP Duminy's elegance.
short ball, angles into Pandey who pulls away for a single.

tragedy for Yuvraj. He's run out backing up too far. Over-pitched on off stump, a typical nothing ball from Trivedi, Pandey bashes it right back, along the ground and Trivedi gets a hand on it. Yuvraj is not even in the frame. Off stump is out of the ground, at the bowler's end.
Botha's spell is over, and it ends with a single as Pandey chips him from outside off to mid-on for a single.

another huge lbw appeal turned down, but this time it looks like Tarapore got it right. Lands well outside off and turns in, Pandey gets the front foot completely outside the line as he looks to sweep. He misses, and is hit outside the line.
straighter, turning down the leg side, Pandey slaps it straight to short fine-leg.
tossed up outside off, and turning in, Pandey leans out and works it to midwicket
flatter on leg stump, Yuvraj hangs back and forces through mid-on
armer from Botha, Yuvraj did not seem to pick it as he pushed and got an inside edge to midwicket for a couple.
Warne's first really poor ball, full toss on the pads, Pandey canters into the whip and drills it fluently through midwicket for four.
flatter, on off, Yuvraj check-drives into the covers and gets the single.
he whips this one, with the spin through midwicket for a couple.
Yuvraj presses out to defend from outside off into the covers.
risky. Wide leggie outside off, Pandey sweeps against the turn and nearly lobs it straight to deep midwicket.
Pandey leans out to defend a full legbreak on off stump.
fuller, on middle, Yuvraj presses out to defend into the off side

shout all you want, Tarapore is not giving any lbws today. Botha lands this on off and it skids on from a length as Yuvraj prods forward. Hit in front of middle. Replays awaited. Botha implores, Tarapore is unmoved. Replays in, that was clipping the outside of leg stump.
aha, Yuvraj shoulders arms to one without much turn that angles in and barely straightens as it comes along. Close to off stump.
fuller on off, Pandey dabs into the cover-point region off the front foot for one more

you won't see a late-cut go finer than that. It was the floater from Botha, holds its line outside off, Pandey waits and waits and opens the face fully to get it away towards the vacant first slip region. It lands and turns finer as it speeds away.
turns in from outside off, slow turn and Pandey defends with the spin to square leg.
tossed up on off, chipped against the spin through the leg side for a single.
Yuvraj is away, driving against the spin through wide mid-off for a single.
tossed up and closer to off, Yuvraj defends into the off side
after eight balls of unstoppable action, a dot ball from Warne. Wide leggie outside off, Yuvraj leaves.

Warne's won the contest at the end of it all! On leg stump again, slightly shorter than before, and straightening, Uthappa was probably ambitious in looking for the reverse sweep again. Uthappa top-edges the reverse sweep, looked like it came off the glove, and Yagnik ran to the leg side to take the catch.
another reverse sweep! Four fours and three near lbws in the seven balls from Warne to Uthappa. Tossed up and in the slot, Uthappa obliges by reaching across and reverse dabbing to fine leg.

Pandey mistimes this completely, but finds the gap and gets a boundary. It was short, but not short enough for him to completely climb onto. He still went for the pull and dragged it away between wide long-on and deep midwicket.
slower ball on off, he spots it and clips it through square leg for one.
lovely shot from Uthappa, it is a short of length ball outside off, the keeper is standing up and he can't jump out, so he just gets half-forward and lofts cleanly through the line.
a hint of inward curve, Pandey inside-edges the drive and gets a single to square leg
straight, on off stump played defensively
Amit angles into the pads, it is worked with the angle through the leg side for one
angles in from wide of the crease, Uthappa works it off the pads for another single.
Pandey slaps off the back foot, through mid on for one more
Uthappa goes through the off side for the fourth single of the over. No pace or movement for Trivedi yet.
Pandey forces another single down the ground.
outside off again, not much pace, Uthappa calmly guides it through point for one more.
back of a length on off stump, Pandey steers through the off side

What. An. Over. Another humongous appeal, Tarapore is unmoved once again. He gestures that this was going down the leg side. Faster from Warne, pushes Uthappa back as he looks to defend a ball that's straightening. He misses. Replays in, this landed half inside the mat and was clipping leg. Another umpire would have given all three out!

huger appeal, again not given, Warne can't believe it! This looked plumber, landed on middle and leg and skidded on as Uthappa pushed forward. My gut feel, this was hitting middle and leg. Replays awaited.
this is an exciting battle already, Uthappa takes him on again. Tossed up on leg, Uthappa reaches out to the pitch and slap-flicks it over midwicket. Well played again.
aha, huge appeal and not given. Fastish leggie, lands on leg and hurries in, Uthappa was on the forward defensive, and was struck in front. Replays say that was hitting off.

this time he gives him the conventional sweep. Warne lands this well outside leg, the shot was on and Uthappa played it well, getting it to speed away towards fine leg. Botha ran across from deep backward square leg and made a mess of it the first time as he went sliding. And then tried again to stop it, but he was in contact with the ropes this time.
aha, Uthappa welcomes him with a reverse sweep. That takes guts! The drifting leggie, Uthappa reaches out to take it on the full and the laps it past the slip fielder. Nicely done.
short of a length and on off again, Pandey tries to force it away into the covers.
tight line on off, Uthappa steers through backward point for one

aha, Uthappa goes aerial, and he wasn't completely in control of it. He thought it was fuller than it was, and just swung straight through the line. Makes good enough contact to send it well up in the air, but importantly, gets it to clear mid-off running back. Couple of bounces and home.
again Amit lands one on the pads, easy runs for Uthappa, he gets the front foot inside the line and flicks fine enough to get his first four.
Pandey lopes out of the crease, Amit angles it into his pads and Pandey whips airily towards fine leg. There is protection there, and he gets a single.
nothing to drive from the seamers so far. On off stump, Pandey defends from the crease.
back of a length on off stump, Uthappa plays it off the back foot towards mid-off.
tight lines, again on a length outside off and Pandey gets a thick outside edge past point.
the epitome of clueless. Angles in from outside off, Uthappa is early on the flick, gets a leading edge, has no idea where it is and looks behind him as he runs away towards third man
heavy ball, bouncer that goes at head-height on this pitch, takes some effort. Uthappa ducks.
Watson again keeps is short of a length, at 134 kph and no movement off the track. Uthappa is solidly behind it and defends.
back of a length on the middle and off line, Pandey works him from the crease towards midwicket.

you just can't keep Botha out of it for long, in this IPL 2011. Ryder's been utterly impatient, looking to charge out almost every ball, and it was getting monotonously predictable. Botha holds it back a touch, again gets it to grip and turn away sharply. Ryder heaves without conviction after prancing out, misses and is stumped by yards.
top bowling from Botha, slows it up as he sees Ryder charging, gets it to spin away and Ryder gets a leading edge as he looks to drive without reaching the pitch.

looks to flick hard again, it is full on the pads and Ryder gets it away to midwicket where the fielder puts in a smart sliding stop to save the boundary. Only two runs taken. Was that Trivedi or Amit Singh?
fires it in, on the pads, Ryder squeezes it away square.
chippy. Ryder's done this a lot this IPL, makes room again, gets close to the pitch and then lofts with the turn, on purpose into the vacant wide long-on area.
haha! Ryder backs away a mile, Botha sees him and lands it on a length straight at him, Ryder has no room in the end and plays a surprised flick that goes nowhere.
armer from Doxy, Pandey doesn't pick it and just manages to stab it away off the inside edge to the leg side.
slower and loopy, Ryder jumps out and can't get to the pitch, he plays it into the covers for one.
that's another poor ball, too short to Ryder who leans back and cracks it away square.
on the pads this time, Pandey whips to the leg side.
better line, fuller on off and Pandey defends.
and four. Poor ball, short and wide outside off, easy smashed cut from Pandey.
shortens the length, Pandey goes back in the crease and defends down the pitch
on off stump and breaking in, Pandey defends with the spin.
as always, a very slow pitch this. Ryder backs away and looks for a big heave but mistimes it past the bowler for one. Bit of a misfield that from Botha.
fuller and on off stump, Ryder looks to dab to the leg side, can't get it away
too straight. On Ryder's pads and he tickles it along to fine leg. The outfield is bald as Andre Agassi's head.
back of a length outside off, hint of slow turn, played with the turn into the covers

Rajasthan lead the table. Pune have lost six on a trot. Rahane - take a bow. Pacy length ball outside off, with the entire field inside on the off. Rahane finds the gap easily with a steer and motors across for the winning run. He then leaps in delight and fist-pumps as he looks at his jubilant dug out. Well done RR!

consider this. It is a high-pressure finish. All we have seen so far is heaves, slashes, whips, murderous slogs etc. What does Rahane play? The late cut! What nerve! It is a slow offcutter outside off, comes in slowly, Rahane keeps his cool and charms it away very fine. Short third man did not have a chance. That's that then for Pune.
full and fast low fulltoss on the pads, Rossco can't flick it away and gets a leg bye.
Rossco retains strike for the final over. He's calmly worked a full ball through the leg side for a single.
how well has Rahane played here? Length ball on the leg stump and he drives to long on for one.

what's happened there? Uthappa has really lost the plot. Nice yorker on off stump, Rossco inside edges as he looks to dig it out, and the inside edge goes to square leg. Rossco wants the second, Rahane responds, they decide late not to go for it, the throw comes in to Uthappa who collects and instead of removing the bails, looks to throw to Taylor's end. Rahane was a metre out and was diving in, Uthappa should have had a go at the batting end!
slower ball, again on a length! Taylor flicks with a vengeance into the deep. It went so fast to the outfielder, Taylor had to hare back for the second. He did.

the crowd is bringing down the roof. Or is it Rossco's shot? They have to stop bowling length to this man. Alfonso lands one on the murder zone, Rossco lines him up and cata-blasts it over midwicket. It lands on the shamiana over the second tier. Humongous.
uh oh, Alfonso's banged this in too short and it is called wide for height.
good ball, full and straight, Rahane bunts to long-on for one. What can Rossco do.
full toss to end the over, he gets away with just a single as Rahane flicks to deep midwicket for a single. Good work from Manhas running in, ensures they don't go for the second.
Rahane comes to the party with a nerveless four! Slower ball from Jerome, Rahane picks it up early and carves over the cover cordon.
almost a yorker, nothing Ross can do with it, he digs it out to point for a single.

Uthappa! Wake up! Length ball, slowish offcutter, Ross swings and misses, it bounces again on the way to Uthappa, who tries to get the pads in the way, but it rebounds off the pads and goes away for two byes.
can't get this away, Taylor plays it back to his name sake, very full and no runs conceded.

another heave, another one lands safe! Taylor gets a length ball outside off, and looks to play his bread and butter slap across the line. It goes nowhere, McCullum runs in from long on and this time can't reach it with his dive. Manish Pandey does well to back him up, running behind and saving the boundary.
length ball to end the over, Taylor bunts through midwicket for another single

if Nathan McCullum doesn't hold on to a catch, it can't be your day. Length ball angling in onto the pads, Taylor shovel slogs it into the deep, McCullum runs across from deep square leg, has it in his reach as he slides, it is in his grasp as he falls and rolls and then it bounces out on impact, hits the chest and thigh before hitting grass. Oh boy.
good bouncer from Alfonso, Taylor decides not to pull as it hurries through
length ball outside off, Rahane gets forward into the check-drive and gets a single wide of mid-on.
and now a full toss on the pads, Taylor whips it square for a single.
Rahane does the wise thing, defends Alfonso from a length into the off side and goes to the bowler's end.
flatter on the stumps, Taylor flicks through square leg for two more. 17 off the over. RR are in front now.

oh, Kartik. Full toss on the pads to Taylor, duly clobbered for a biggie over midwicket. There are many balls Kartik could have bowled in this situation. Full toss on Taylor's pads has got to be the worst. The ball might have gone to Jodhpur, says Harsha Bhogle.
I have been a huge fan of Murali Kartik for many years, but I must say this is the worst I have ever seen him bowl. Another short ball outside off, Taylor shreds it away through point.
appeal for stumping, but Taylor is in. Looks to sweep a length ball turning away from outside off, he misses and Uthappa collects and breaks the stumps. Taylor's toe never went out though.
horrible day this for Kartik. Loops one into Taylor's hitting zone and he smacks across the line to cow corner.
flighted on the toes, worked through long on for a single.
put your hands together for Rahul S. He's finished with a wicket-maiden. Finishes with the faster one, it is through Taylor in no time as he looks to cut.
this is really good bowling, he's varying his lengths a touch this way and that. This one is shorter, and it breaks away sharply, Taylor feels for it and can't touch it.
more air, Taylor leans out and drives to mid-off.
another one very close to off, not much turn, and Taylor misses the cut.
flat ball outside off, cut away straight to point. Taylor has to take this home from here.

is it too late in the game? Rahul Sharma has got Menaria to mis-hit one of his big swings into the leg side. Superb catch from Alfonso Thomas, who, for me, has been the best Pune player in this IPL. This was in the slot, Menaria lined him up and looked to go downtown, but lofted it towards wide long-on. Alfonso runs across from long-on and takes it.
Taylor joins the fun, leans out to the flight and flicks through midwicket for a couple.
flatter this time, Menaria is alert to the single, pushing in front of square.
Pune are coming down with a case of Malaria here. Tossed up on the stumps, Menaria makes room, chips a step outside and bashes him over long-on for a big six.
Taylor pushes a ball to long on for a single.

the running between these two isn't the best. Another moment of uncertainty between Taylor and Menaria. Short of a length outside off, cut into the deep, They get the first, think of the second scramble out of the crease out of synchrony and then decide against it.
flat and just outside off, cut away towards point.
another single, Menaria glances through backward square leg for a single.
talk to the bottom hand. Menaria gets half forward to a short of length ball and muscles it straight down the ground, over the ropes. This over might have turned the game RR's way.
fuller ball, on the stumps, Taylor leans forward and works it through mid-on.
nicely done this time, Taylor gets a foot of width outside off and slashes away through point for four. He's doing the job today.
fires it in from wide of the crease, Taylor defends it down the track.
flat outside off, Menaria cuts it away from close to off stump for a single through point.
nice ball, hurries the armer into Menaria who inside-edges it past the stumps for a single.
works a single this time to short third man, dabbing it away
this is what Taylor does when he's under pressure. Kiwi mate, Nathan M must know. Angles and offie in, Taylor gets the front foot across and slap slogs through square leg for a crucial four.
hmm, the pressure is getting to them. Armer outside off, Taylor looks to steer and finds point. They think of a single, and belatedly decide against. Just in time.
good old heave-ho. Menaria comes out, is miles from the pitch of the ball and then heaves without timing to the leg side for one.
speared in from round the wicket, Menaria defends from the crease.
quicker through the air, good stuff from Rahul S. Taylor gets behind the line and defends to the off side
not much turn, lands outside off and holds the line, Taylor defends down the track.
fuller on middle, worked with the spin through midwicket
legbreak this time on middle and moving away, Taylor pushes towards mid-on for a single.
lovely wrong 'un, hurried in from outside off and Taylor doesn't spot it as he inside edges the cut. That could have gone anywhere.

another reverse sweep expert perishes to the reverse sweep today. Rahul Sharma fires this in very full on middle, Botha tries to take it on the full and reverse slap it through third man, but the ball thuds into his boot before the bat can come down. Plumb and given by Taufel. I reckon even Tarapore would have given this out.

Menaria plays a shot straight out of the Yuvraj book of audacity. Another really pacy ball, but it is on the pads. Menaria ensures he is inside the line and flicks with disdain safely over deep backward square leg. Remember Yuvraj smashing Lee in the 2007 World T20? Of course you do .. I am not saying this was as good, but for a moment it reminded me of that.
nice bouncer, Menaria decides to let it go outside off.

aha, a lot of drama. Jerome hustles Botha with a pacy ball that nips in from outside off stump, he was hit in front of leg, high on the pad, and even as the appeal went up, he hurried across. Ryder picks up and hurls, but Botha gets in the way of the throw. Ouch.
straighter, comes in at 137 kph and ends on middle and leg. Botha defends from the crease to the leg side.
back of a length outside off, Botha stays behind the line and steers it to point
slow offcutter at 114 kph on leg stump, it bounces extra on Menaria who turns it square for a single
fired in on the pads, Menaria works it along to deep midwicket for a single.
this time he gets it away to deep point, and Harpreet does well to keep them to a single.
that kept low, turned in slowly from outside off and Botha mistimes the cut.
no turn for Nathan, on the pads again and Menaria clips it for one more through square leg.
flat ball, turns in onto the pads and Botha works it square for a single.
on the pads, Menaria glances it down to fine leg for a single. Did not get bat on it though.

if he'd pre-meditated the sweep any more, he'd have played it off the previous ball. Botha leans the front foot across and waits. The ball lands on leg stump and he paddles it around towards fine leg.
on the pads this time, Menaria whips through square leg for a single.
flat and hurries through, Menaria gets behind the line and defends.
back of a length outside off, Menaria defends.
tossed up outside off, he leans out and defends.

there's something about this IPL, it just doesn't let Dravid carry on with his starts, and he seems to keep getting out to soft dismissals. Here's another. His namesake drops this short and slow, it sits up like a cookie that has to be consumed in a hurry, Dravid goes for the pull and ends up slapping it right back at the bowler. Nicely held.
fullish on leg stump, Botha whips to midwicket

reverse sweep, we have seen a few of those today, and Botha's scored around half his runs in IPL 2011 using this shot. Tossed up on the stumps, Botha reverses the stance and comes down on it hard and keeps it fine of short third man. Easy does it.
Botha gets this away for a couple more, pushed in front of square easily.
sharp turn away from Botha, who gets the bat away at the last moment.
Dravid gets a short ball outside off and curs it away for a single

Botha survives a run out chance, from Ryder. Where was Yuvraj,, wasn't he supposed to be backing up? Flat ball on the pads, Dravid whips to wide long-on, Ryder comes across and hurls the throw, Botha has already come on for the second, Dravid responds very late, Botha dived in, the throw missed, and no one was there to collect it.

Harpreet drops one now. Pear-shaped is how things are going, for Pune. Dravid moves the front foot down the track and mows Kartik across the line, he doesn't middle it and it is in mid-on's sights. Harpreet moved to his right, timed the jump well and got both hands to it, over his head. He did not hold on, and then tried to take the rebound behind him, and missed that as well.
good ball, through Dravid faster than he thought, and missed the cut.
flatter ball, hurries through outside off and Botha forces off the back foot through mid-off
this time he lands it outside off, but that doesn't stop Dravid from reaching across and flicking for one more.
tossed up, Botha gets forward and works against the spin through midwicket
tossed up on the stumps, Dravid whips through midwicket.
top over this from Alfonso, a really good wicket-maiden. This one nips in from back of a length, and Botha goes for an ambitious slap-pull that he misses, and is hit high on the pad.
Botha is forward again, gets onto the front foot and pushes into the off side
fuller length and straighter, Botha is reluctantly forward as he pushes into the covers.
and another one that scoots along after landing on a length. Fortunately it was well outside off, and Botha did not play at it.

top delivery from Alfonso, he's nailed Watto with the classic away seamer. Probably not entirely intended, it came out with a scrambled seam, but landed on the thread outside off after angling in, and straightened. Watson did not spot the deviation, got half forward and drove, but it kissed the outside edge and settled into Uthappa's gloves. Gone.
angles a quick ball into Watson, who plays it towards mid-on.

clocked at 139.6 kph, but that bouncer seemed faster than that. Dravid rose with the bounce and then let it go, it was past him well outside off, and into Uthappa's gloves by the time he landed back on his toes.
slower ball, comes in from outside off, Watson stays behind the line and guides to third man
stupendous yorker from Taylor, it's got to be a real good ball to have Watto in strife. He hops away, protects the toes and pushes it into the off side
this one angles into the pads, Dravid whips backward of point for a single.
pacy and outside off this time, Dravid tries to force the square drive, but is beaten for pace. On the bounce to Uthappa, who fumbles.
good ball, on a length and hurries in towards Dravid who misses the whip on the back foot. Half an appeal, but that was sliding down the leg side.

if you are a spinner, and you bowl long enough on a length in line with the stumps, Watson will eventually show you the way to the midwicket. He just did that to Rahul Sharma, making room and slogging him emphatically into the stands. Good start for RR this.
drifting onto the pads, Watson misses the flick and is hit on the pads.
flatter from Rahul, Watson covers the line and defends from the crease.
Dravid over-reaches for the flight on leg stump and then whips it backward of square leg for one
hint of drift onto the pads, Watson nudges it off the pads to square leg for one
length ball turning from leg stump, defended by Watson
slower ball from Alfonso, Dravid leans out and mis-times into the covers.
back of a length outside off, Dravid steers towards point
aha, another tight inducker from Alfonso, this time Dravid leaves and it whistles by close to off stump
another top shot from Dravid. Alfonso cuts this in from a length, it ends on Dravid's hips and he whips it backward of square for four more.

Pune are off to a horror start on the field. Another lazy effort, this time from Yuvraj who moves slowly and dives late. Lovely hit from Dravid, stays behind the line and punches with Test match class, and Yuvraj responds with an average effort.
touch of movement away from Watson, from outside off, and it is cut away square for a single.
Watson reaches out to a tossed up ball on leg and whips another single.
flatter on middle, Dravid again works a single to midwicket

Pandey has dropped it, but it's fair to say that was a toughie. Watson gets one in his hitting zone from a left-arm spinner and looks to slog-sweep over midwicket. Top-edge, takes off and hurtles down towards an untenanted wide  mid-on. Pandey from long on and McCullum from deep midwicket converge, Pandey swoops in, has it in reach but fails to hold on. McCullum wistfully pats his head after both of them get up.
fired in on the pads, Watson flicks straight to square leg for one
flat, on middle stump, whipped through midwicket for one
and Dravid doesn't touch the free-hit. Length ball, lands outside leg and turns in, Dravid looks to heave with a crossed bat and misses. So does Uthappa. Four byes.
Not a wise start. He over-steps and sends down a half-tracker, that Watto pulls straight to the man in the deep.
